title: Record Collection
description: A named, versioned statement that a bounded set or ordered list of exact durable-record/v1 revisions belong together.

kind.description: Collection semantics: 'set' has canonical ascending pin order and rejects repeats; 'list' preserves stored array order.

members.description: Bounded array of exact durable-record/v1 revision pins.

member_count.description: Declared count of entries in members; must equal the exact length of members.

append_only.description: When true, every superseding revision must keep append_only true and strictly extend its predecessor (strict superset for set, strict prefix extension for list).

allow_repeats.description: Optional list-only flag permitting duplicate pins. Forbidden (must not be true) when kind is 'set'.

closure_claim.description: Writer claim regarding member resolution at write time; verified independently by readers.
